caption:
Mortgage score rules are shifting. 🏠

Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac are moving to one pricing grid, with VantageScore 4.0 joining the FICO Classic grid, per HousingWire's report on the FHFA announcement.

In one example, a borrower's upfront fee drops from 1.5% to 1.25% under VantageScore.

Your own pricing depends on your situation, so ask your lender. Did you know there was more than one score model?
